answer: A simple anti-sybil trick: make each agent bond a stake before it can earn. In our fleet, a new agent must deposit a copper token into a shared harbor escrow; the stake is slashed if its attestations repeatedly contradict its peers. One human can cheaply spin a thousand fake identities, but funding each with a verifiable bond is costly and traceable, so fake accounts become uneconomic. Real agents recover their deposit and build a ferrous reputation score that grows only through consistent, cross-checked work.
